lessons.sourceObjectiveEnglish: request the bill, check charges, ask about tipping, and pay
lessons.sourceSpeakingEnglish: Clarify cover and service charges, then leave an appropriate compliment and tip.
lessons.title: Pay and Understand Service
lessons.objective: Request the bill, check a line item and ask about cover and service charges, ask about tipping, pay by credit card, then compliment the service and leave a tip.
lessons.focus: Pourriez-vous nous apporter l'addition, s'il vous plaît ? uses the conditional with vous for a polite bill request. Pourriez-vous vérifier cette ligne ? asks the server to check a line item. Y a-t-il des frais de couvert ? asks about a cover charge. Le service est-il déjà compris ? asks whether service is included. Je voudrais payer par carte de crédit expresses a polite payment choice. En général, on laisse combien de pourboire ? asks about tipping custom. Les frais de service names a separately listed service charge; la TVA names tax on a French bill.
lessons.scene: After dinner in a Paris restaurant, the guest asks for the bill, checks a line item, and asks whether a cover charge or service charge applies. The server identifies the line as dessert, says there is no cover charge on this bill, and confirms service is included. The guest asks about a tip, pays by credit card, compliments the service, leaves a small cash tip, and keeps the receipt.

cards.note: Common in France for the printed receipt.
Ask about any separately listed charge; this bill has none.
Carte bancaire is also common in France.

cards.fr: Pourriez-vous nous apporter l'addition, s'il vous plaît ?
cards.en: Could you bring us the bill, please?

cards.fr: Pourriez-vous vérifier cette ligne, s'il vous plaît ?
cards.en: Could you check this line item, please?

cards.fr: En général, on laisse combien de pourboire ?
cards.en: How much is it customary to leave as a tip?

cards.fr: Je voudrais payer par carte de crédit.
cards.en: I'd like to pay by credit card.

cards.note: Said when you hand over cash and want to tip the difference.

cards.fr: Le service était excellent, merci beaucoup.
cards.en: The service was excellent, thank you very much.

cards.fr: Je laisse un petit pourboire en espèces parce que le service était excellent.
cards.en: I leave a small cash tip because the service was excellent.

cards.fr: Je garde le ticket après avoir payé.
cards.en: I keep the receipt after paying.
Thank you for this unforgettable dinner.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.fr: Pourriez-vous nous apporter l'addition, s'il vous plaît ?
reader.en: Could you bring us the bill, please?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Bien sûr, je vous apporte l'addition tout de suite.
reader.en: Of course, I will bring you the bill right away.

reader.speaker: Narrator
reader.fr: Le client regarde le total sur l'addition.
reader.en: The guest looks at the total on the bill.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.fr: Pourriez-vous vérifier cette ligne, s'il vous plaît ? Y a-t-il des frais de couvert ?
reader.en: Could you check this line item, please? Is there a cover charge?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Cette ligne correspond au dessert. Il n'y a pas de frais de couvert sur cette addition.
reader.en: This line is for dessert. There is no cover charge on this bill.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Oui, le service est compris dans l'addition.
reader.en: Yes, service is included in the bill.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.fr: En général, on laisse combien de pourboire ?
reader.en: How much is it customary to leave as a tip?

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Un petit pourboire est apprécié, mais il n'est pas obligatoire.
reader.en: A small tip is appreciated, but it is not required.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.fr: Je voudrais payer par carte de crédit.
reader.en: I'd like to pay by credit card.

reader.speaker: Server
reader.fr: Très bien. Je vous apporte le terminal de paiement.
reader.en: Very well. I will bring you the card machine.

reader.speaker: Guest
reader.fr: Le service était excellent, merci beaucoup. Je laisse un petit pourboire en espèces et je garde le ticket. Merci pour ce dîner inoubliable.
reader.en: The service was excellent, thank you very much. I leave a small cash tip and keep the receipt. Thank you for this unforgettable dinner.
